job.title: Water proofer - Commercial - Brisbane
job.description:
Join an experienced commercial waterproofing crew on an active Sunshine Coast, Brisbane and Gold Coast projects with an immediate start available. You'll work alongside skilled tradespeople applying a range of waterproofing systems to commercial specifications. This is a contract role with strong hourly rates, weekly pay, and the potential for ongoing work as the project progresses. We also offer full time positions for the right people.

 

Duties

  • Prepare surfaces and complete detailing to a high standard
  • Read and work from plans and project specifications
  • Maintain site safety standards and WHS compliance at all times
  • Coordinate with site supervisors on daily tasks and priorities

 

Skills & Experience

  • Proven commercial waterproofing experience — essential
  • Trade qualified 
  • White Card — mandatory
  • Working at Heights ticket — highly regarded
  • EWP or Confined Space ticket — advantageous
  • Own tools and reliable transport to site

 

Culture

Work for a company that makes you enjoy going to work. The projects are interesting and the company believes in a high standard of quality and safety.

 

Benefits

  • $50–$55 per hour based on experience
  • Weekly pay — no waiting for your money
  • Penalties and overtime rates available
  • Travel allowance paid
  • Immediate start on an active commercial project
  • Monday - Friday work
  • Will provide accommodation or travel allowance if travelling over 60kms

Direct support from Chantal and the Siteforce team throughout your placement

Note: The benefits section lists all available benefits from the original ad. No limit on bullet points per SEEK guidelines — all tangible benefits are included.

 

How to Apply

Click APPLY to submit your resume, or contact Chantal at Siteforce Recruitment directly: admin@siteforcerecruitment.com.au

We'll be in touch within 24 hours to discuss the role and next steps. Only apply if you meet the criteria and reside in Queensland

job.title: Contracts Administrator - Brisbane
job.description:
Build Your Career with a Leading Commercial Builder

Siteforce Recruitment is proud to partner with a highly regarded commercial construction company with a strong pipeline of work across Brisbane and South East Queensland.

We are seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to join a collaborative and high-performing team delivering a diverse range of childcare centres, high rise and health care..

This is an excellent opportunity to join a respected builder offering long-term career growth, challenging projects and a supportive team culture.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity

  • $130,000 - $190,000 + Super (negotiable based on experience)
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Diverse portfolio of childcare, commercial and civil projects
  • Strong pipeline of secured work across Brisbane
  • Genuine career progression opportunities
  • Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment
  • Modern systems and established processes
  • Work for a respected builder with an outstanding reputation for quality

About Siteforce Recruitment

Siteforce Recruitment specialises in connecting skilled construction professionals with some of Australia's leading construction companies. We are committed to matching experienced candidates with employers who offer long-term career opportunities and supportive workplace cultures.

About the Role

Working closely with the Project Manager and site teams, you will be responsible for the commercial management of projects from procurement through to completion.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing subcontract procurement and contract administration
  • Preparing subcontract agreements and purchase orders
  • Cost reporting, budgeting and forecasting
  • Processing progress claims and subcontractor payments
  • Managing variations and Extension of Time (EOT) claims
  • Monitoring project budgets and financial performance
  • Maintaining contract and procurement registers
  • Liaising with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Assisting with project delivery and commercial outcomes
  • Coordinating final accounts and project close-out documentation

Skills & Experience

To be successful, you will have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience as a Contract Administrator within commercial construction
  • Experience delivering childcare, commercial and/or civil construction projects
  • Experience working for a Tier 1 builder or Tier 2 builders or reputable commercial construction companies
  • Degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering or a related discipline
  • Strong understanding of Queensland building legislation, the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local construction practices
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Queensland building codes, construction methodologies and compliance requirements
  • Experience with procurement, contract administration, cost control, forecasting, variations and EOTs
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills
  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Experience using Jobpac, Procore, Cheops or similar construction management software is advantageous

Apply Now

If you're ready to take the next step in your construction career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Chantal at Siteforce Recruitment for a confidential discussion. 0410 928 512 

Applicants must have unrestricted Australian working rights and currently reside in Australia to be considered for this position.

job.title: Carpenter for carports, patios, and decks
job.description:
Carports, Patios & Decks | Southside and Northside projects available

 Same-Day Payments | Ongoing Work

Are you an experienced outdoor construction installer looking for consistent work with a reputable company? We are seeking skilled subcontract fitters to join our growing team installing high-quality carports, patios and decks across Brisbane and surrounding suburbs. Get given the jobs so you don't have to worry about finding them yourself. Then get paid the same day. No need to wait!

If you have experience constructing outdoor structures and take pride in delivering quality workmanship, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'll be responsible for constructing outdoor living projects from start to finish using premium Apollo and Ausdeck patio systems.

Projects include:

  • Carports
  • Insulated patios
  • Single-skin patios
  • Steel-framed composite decking

The majority of our decking projects use steel framing and composite decking, with very little timber work involved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construct carports, patios and decks from start to finish
  • Read and interpret building plans accurately
  • Install steel framing, roofing and finishing components
  • Ensure all work complies with Australian building standards and local council requirements
  • Maintain a clean, safe and professional worksite
  • Deliver high-quality workmanship on every project

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience installing patios, carports or decking systems
  • Ability to read and follow construction plans
  • Current ABN
  • Own tools and reliable transport
  • Current White Card
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in your work
  • Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines
  • Willingness to travel throughout Brisbane and surrounding suburbs

What's on Offer

  • Highly competitive project rates
  • Same-day payment upon receipt of your invoice after successful completion of each project
  • Ongoing pipeline of work
  • Flexible subcontract opportunities
  • Supportive team and well-organised project scheduling
  • Opportunity to work on premium outdoor construction projects

While we always aim to schedule projects close to your preferred location, flexibility to travel throughout our Brisbane service region is expected.

If you're an experienced installer looking for ongoing work with excellent earning potential and prompt payment, apply today!

Please note: Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Australia and reside in Australia to be considered for this opportunity.

job.title: Storeman
job.description:
Warehouse & Materials Coordinator – Building & Construction

$35–$40 per hour casual | $70,000–$85,000 per year permanent

Take ownership of material orders, warehouse stock and site deliveries in a busy construction environment.

Siteforce Recruitment is seeking a capable Warehouse & Materials Coordinator to keep materials moving from suppliers through to site. Your work will directly support construction teams by ensuring the right products arrive in the right quantities, when they’re needed.

This is a hands-on coordination role for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, building strong supplier relationships and solving problems before they affect progress on site.

About the role

You’ll manage the day-to-day warehouse and materials function, working closely with suppliers and site teams to understand requirements, place orders and coordinate deliveries. When quantities, products or schedules change, you’ll keep orders updated and everyone informed.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Ordering building materials against site requirements and work schedules.

  • Confirming product details, quantities, availability and delivery timeframes.

  • Managing order amendments, cancellations, shortages and supplier follow-ups.

  • Coordinating deliveries with site teams to support planned works.

  • Checking incoming materials against orders and resolving missing or incorrect items.

  • Maintaining stock records and monitoring materials available in the warehouse.

  • Organising materials for dispatch and keeping the warehouse safe and accessible.

  • Identifying potential supply delays early and arranging practical solutions.

About you

You’re organised, dependable and comfortable managing several priorities at once. You follow through on orders, communicate clearly and understand how a missed delivery can affect an entire site team.

We’re looking for:

  • Experience in warehouse operations, materials coordination, purchasing or a similar role.

  • Strong attention to detail when checking orders, quantities and delivery information.

  • Confidence dealing with suppliers and coordinating with site personnel.

  • The ability to adapt quickly when site requirements change.

  • Good computer skills for maintaining orders and stock records.

  • Building materials experience and a Forklift Licence are highly regarded.

What’s on offer

  • Casual employment at $35–$40 per hour, with a clear pathway to permanent full-time.

  • Alternatively, permanent full-time employment at $70,000–$85,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • A role with responsibility across the warehouse and materials function.

  • The opportunity to contribute directly to the smooth delivery of construction projects.

Apply now with your resume highlighting your warehouse, purchasing or building materials experience.

Applicants must be Australian permanent residents to be considered.

job.title: Formwork carpenter
job.description:
Commercial Formwork Carpenter

We are seeking an experienced and reliable Commercial Formwork Carpenter to join our team. The role involves constructing, assembling, and dismantling formwork systems for large-scale commercial and civil projects. You will play a key part in ensuring concrete structures are built to specification, safely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read and interpret construction drawings and specifications to determine formwork requirements.

  • Measure, cut, assemble, and install timber, steel, or prefabricated formwork systems for walls, slabs, beams, columns, and stairs.

  • Erect, align, and secure formwork panels, supports, and braces to the correct dimensions and levels.

  • Place reinforcement supports, void formers, and embedded fixtures within formwork.

  • Assist with concrete pours, compaction, and finishing as required.

  • Safely strip, dismantle, and maintain formwork once concrete has cured.

  • Operate a range of hand tools, power tools, and equipment associated with formwork carpentry.

  • Maintain and repair formwork systems for ongoing use.

  • Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to meet project timelines.

  • Adhere to all workplace health and safety requirements, including the correct use of PPE and safe work practices.

Skills and Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Formwork Carpenter in commercial  construction.

  • Strong understanding of formwork systems, concrete structures, and construction processes.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and plans.

  • Competent in the use of hand tools, power tools, and construction equipment.

  • Physically fit, reliable, and safety-focused.

  • White Card and relevant trade qualifications 

  • Benefits

    • Consistent, long-term project work across commercial sites

    • Opportunities for career progression and training.

    • Supportive team culture and safe working environment.

PLEASE SEND YOUR RESUME FIRST BEFORE CALLING
If the above sounds like you and you have all the necessary tickets and licenses  admin@siteforcerecruitment.com.au or call Chantal: 0410 928 512
